latest_release.body:
**v1.3.0: Windows builder improvements, native iPhone and iPad navigation, and Japanese / Windows 构建器优化、iPhone 和 iPad 原生导航与日语支持**

## English

**Highlights**

**iPhone and iPad app**
- The app has native navigation (#787).
- The library layout adapts to iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo (#787).
- A touch controls editor is included (#695, #622, #787).
- The Duo outer landscape accepts custom control bounds (#809, #787).

**New**
- **Experimental builder is off by default**: The setting is in Settings, Build tools, "Use experimental builder". It stays off until you turn it on, and the launcher builds with the NSP script as before. The app bundles `nxb 0.9.3` of nxkit, the new name of nxbuild (#902, #921, #976).
- **Engine pin**: The engine is pinned to `c78d7375` (#861, #902, #976).
- **Japanese**: The launcher and the iPhone and iPad shell now speak Japanese, by @Haseenesss (#718, #866).
- **Native iPhone and iPad app**: The app has native navigation and adaptive library layouts, with a touch controls editor, by @jonochocki (#695, #622, #787).
- **Cleaner TV play**: The settings gear hides during TV play with a controller. The Duo outer landscape accepts custom control bounds (#809, #787).
- **Game titles as Mac app names**: A compiled Mac game gets its game title as the app name, and a rebuild can rename an old numeric app. If a Dock item, alias or shortcut stops opening the game, recreate it from the renamed app. Saves and launch options stay, by @thehobbit85 (#404, #846).
- **Multi-game cartridges**: Choose which game to build, on the Mac and in the Qt launcher, by @thehobbit85 (#376, #821, #845).
- **Library search**: Find games in the Mac library by title or with Command-F, by @thehobbit85 (#824).
- **Change artwork**: It opens a panel to pick and frame the hero and the thumbnail, by @Koshindai (#798).
- **Faster builds**: A build reuses the other platform's `romfs.img` instead of extracting it again, by @Haseenesss (#708, #790).
- **iPhone game data notice**: The launcher says when the iPhone game data changed since the last copy, by @thehobbit85 (#261, #819).
- **Open on device**: Available for a library game that also plays on the Mac, by @thehobbit85 (#844).
- **Progress display**: Progress shows in the Update button and during the Pipeline archive stage (#833, #835).
- **Windows shared mode**: It builds `DmGame.framework` and exports `NX2Apple.ipa` (#850).
- **Windows extractor bundled**: A build needs no NuGet restore, by @thehobbit85 (#815).

**Fixed**
- **Little Nightmares II**: The game now reads its encrypted legacy Unreal pak, by @Haseenesss (#877, #893).
- **Fire Emblem: Three Houses**: The shader split for v327680 is fixed, by @thehobbit85 (#788, #843).
- **CPU BC textures**: Uploads and views are fixed, by @class-undefined (#888).
- **Switch 2 dumps**: Nested folders are now handled (#859).
- **Translocated launcher copy**: It now updates where it was started from, by @Haseenesss (#873, #881).
- **Shared shell and Windows build**: The signature expiry is fixed. On Windows, the `metal.exe` choice, the SDK download and Metal outputs in non-ASCII folders are fixed (#842, #891).
- **Windows symbol check**: Windows checks the symbols the shell really loads, by @Stellarznith (#882).
- **Italian controller texts**: They are reviewed, by @Dino0005 (#890).
- **Mac launcher**: Several smaller fixes, by @thehobbit85 (#848, #852, #853, #857).
- **Mac setup without keys**: Setup no longer needs `prod.keys` for decrypted Switch 2 game folders and NUP files (Continue without keys), by @thehobbit85 (#696, #822).
- **Bundled Qt launcher**: It no longer updates unrelated checkouts, by @thehobbit85 (#847).
- **nxb builds**: Games that nxb builds for the shared iPhone and iPad app install again. `nxb 0.9.3` no longer stops at the rewrite when an engine file differs from a pinned hash, by @STRML (#912, #916, #921, #942, #976, nxkit#11, nxkit#18).
- **Mesh draws on Apple GPUs**: Draws with no task shader are split into grids of at most

detail.readme_excerpt:
**Your Switch games, running on your iPhone.** **Not an emulator. No terminal. A macOS or Windows app does the whole build in a few clicks.** [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/network/members) [![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](LICENSE) [![Games](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FLNPANDY%2FNX2Apple%2Fmain%2F.github%2Fbadges%2Fgames.json)](.github/badges/games.json) [![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇨🇳_中文-available-green)](README.zh-CN.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇺🇸_English-current-blue)](README.md) [![Svenska](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇸🇪_Svenska-available-green)](README.sv.md) [![Deutsch](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇩🇪_Deutsch-available-green)](README.de.md) [![Français](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇫🇷_Français-available-green)](README.fr.md) [![Italiano](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇮🇹_Italiano-available-green)](README.it.md) #### 🆕 Latest highlights - **Windows launcher (`NX2Apple-windows-x64.zip`)**: Build iPhone and iPad IPAs on Windows with the same 1.2 interface, a bundled engine tree (no git needed), guided first-run setup, multi-core NSO rewriting, and in-app self-update (`NX2Apple.exe`). - **Switch 2 games**: Pick a Switch 2 game folder or `.nup` file in the Mac or Windows launcher, with no `prod.keys` needed, and play on Mac, iPhone, or iPad. - **Custom touch controls, split Joy-Con, and Steam Controller (2026)**: Resize buttons, move the left stick, or arrange every control in the visual layout editor on iPhone and iPad. Physical controllers support per-game or global button remapping, split a Bluetooth Joy-Con pair into two sideways controllers on Mac, and support the Steam Controller (2026). - **One app for iPhone and iPad**: All your games live inside one shell app (or export an unsigned IPA for AltStore and SideStore), each carrying its own host framework so engine updates never force a rebuild, with Cover Flow in landscape, per-game settings and mods, safe game deletion that keeps your saves, and 7 languages. - **Console mode**: Plug in a controller and press Select, or start directly in console mode. The library goes full-screen like a Switch home menu, and holding Home for 2 seconds quits a game. Every release is in the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md).
